newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PLDT dips 2.05 pct on ADR fall.
newsitem.headline: PLDT dips 2.05 pct on ADR fall.

text.p: Dominant carrier Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co lost 15 pesos, or 2.05 percent, to 715 pesos in early Friday trade in reaction to the significant drop of its American Depositary Receipts in New York.
"There's no special reason except that people just reacted to how PLDT did in New York," said Corazon Guidote, head of Philippine equities at UBS Securities (East Asia) Ltd.
Bucking the Dow Jones' 47-point rise, PLDT's ADR fell by $1 1/4 on Thursday, closing at $53 1/8.
PLDT was one of the top ten most actively traded issue early in the session with a turnover of 33.6 million pesos.
